scope: 98 distinct public professional counterparts, plus two separately sourced public-figure cast members in public_figure_backgrounds.json.
notice: These are public professional references for fictional characters, not a register of actual residents or employees. Sources establish only the listed career facts at their stated dates. Synthetic ages, work status, workplaces, housing, finances, childhood and recent events are not facts or inferences about the referenced people. No private contact details are collected.
selection_basis: Convenience selection from publicly accessible institutional biographies, first-person professional interviews and official career recognitions. Bay Area professional connections do not establish current SF residence. Coverage is neither representative nor an employer staffing survey.
